title: Don’t Erase, Inform! Detecting and Contextualizing Harmful Language in Cultural Heritage Collections

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting contentious terms related to ethno-religious identity (e.g., antisemitism) in cultural heritage metadata using a co-created multilingual vocabulary and LLM-based contextual disambiguation.
Detecting outdated or offensive terms related to race and ethnicity in historical metadata records using a custom NLP pipeline involving lemmatization, string matching, and LLM disambiguation.
Identifying harmful or biased language regarding gender identity in cultural heritage collections using a knowledge graph of contentious terms and an AI-powered detection tool.
Detecting derogatory or outdated terms related to LGBTQIA+ communities in metadata using string matching and contextual evaluation by Large Language Models.
Flagging and contextualizing historically biased language related to migration and colonial pasts in cultural heritage datasets via a human-in-the-loop validated NLP tool.
Detecting contentious terminology related to disabilities in historical text using a structured multilingual vocabulary and an AI classification pipeline.
